attr.title: ReNFS5: Open Unleashed
attr.desc: Need for Speed: Porsche Unleashed (2000) on the open-source Open-Unleashed engine by Second-Boot (github.com/Second-Boot/Open-Unleashed) with a native OpenGL ES 3 renderer for handhelds (about 60 FPS in races on H700). Graphics, audio and input go through the firmware's SDL2 and gptokeyb2; nothing is linked to a GPU or audio driver. A native launcher imports and verifies your own game files (folder, ZIP or CD image) and offers settings: frame cap, FPS counter, GLES or Vulkan, movies, game screen.
attr.inst: Extract nfs5.zip into the device's ports folder. Put your own installed game folder (with FEData and GameData), a .zip of it, or a CD image with the installed game into nfs5/source/. The launcher imports it into nfs5/data/ on first start (allow ~1.5 GiB free). Saves are kept in nfs5/saves/, settings in nfs5/configs/. Requires AArch64 firmware with glibc 2.30+, SDL2 2.0.12+ and an OpenGL ES 3.0 driver that SDL2 can load.
